## Summary

Describe the problem and the change. Link the related issue, if any.

## Verification

List the exact test commands and results, including failures or skipped tests.
For GUI changes, describe light/dark theme and window-size checks. Attach only
redacted screenshots or synthetic data.

## Compatibility and risks

Explain effects on saved data, schema migration, Elo calculations, historical
replay, or packaged releases. State "None" when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read CONTRIBUTING.md and followed CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
- [ ] I added or updated tests and documentation where appropriate.
- [ ] I checked `git diff --check` and reviewed the files being committed.
- [ ] I excluded credentials, personal league data, backups, logs, and unrelated build/cache outputs.
- [ ] I appended the change and actual verification/publication status to `历史工作记录.txt`.
- [ ] I identified any licensing or third-party attribution questions for the maintainer.
